email.subject1: a signal play for Higher Logic
email.body1:
David, saw Higher Logic launched the Vanilla MCP server and brought on a new Chief Community Officer to lead AI-powered engagement.

A push that big usually opens more in-market accounts than sales engineering and the reps can cover before they ramp, and that is where deals stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Higher Logic off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
David, quick follow-up for Higher Logic.

With a new AI direction, expectations on pipeline tend to jump faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Higher Logic needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
David, last bit of proof for Higher Logic.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Higher Logic's reply rate likely compares to other community-software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
David, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything when you are rolling out a new AI direction, and that stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Higher Logic either way.
